title: Salute 25 Years of Adult Swim by Marathoning the TV Block’s Iconic ‘Infomercials’ Online
summary: From "Unedited Footage of a Bear" to "This House Has People in It," Cartoon Network's late-night programming oddities should outlive the TV format that inspired them.

title: ‘The Scout’ Review: A Meditative Look at Life as an Oft-Ignored Movie Location Scout
summary: Paula González-Nasser's quiet directorial debut follows a location scout in New York City who becomes a quasi-therapist for every resident she visits.

title: Three Decades Ago, He Made a Documentary About Then-Boyfriend Isaac Mizrahi — Now, Douglas Keeve Is Looking Back at ‘Unzipped’
summary: As Keeve tells IndieWire, his relationship with then-rising fashion mogul Mizrahi fell apart after he made the 1995 fashion-world doc. But the film isn't what split them in two.

title: Stanley Kubrick’s Five Best Films, Ranked with TCM Host Ben Mankiewicz
summary: With his "The Plot Thickens" podcast focused on Kubrick this season, Mankiewicz joins IndieWire's own podcast "Screen Talk" to rank his favorites alongside co-hosts Anne Thompson and Ryan Lattanzio.

title: A24’s ‘Primetime’ Earns $2.7 Million in Previews as Robert Pattinson’s Creepy Chris Hansen Scores at the Box Office
summary: "Avengers: Endgame Encore" earns a mighty $3.8 million as it returns to theaters.

title: Brad Pitt and David Ayer Had None of Your Typical Film Set Comforts on the Survival Thriller ‘Heart of the Beast’
summary: Ayer tells IndieWire's Filmmaker Toolkit podcast about the challenges of telling an adventure story about a man and his dog, where the project's stripped-down nature makes every decision exponentially more important.

title: Congress Must Act to Support Cinemas Tax Credit and Keep Movies on Main Street
summary: In an op-ed, four independent exhibitors push for the passage of the SCREEN Act, a tax break for movie theater reinvestment.

title: ‘The Gilded Age’ Musical Is Finally Happening — as a Christmas Album
summary: "Voices of The Gilded Age: The Christmas Album" puts the HBO series' cast of Broadway stars to proper use, with Audra McDonald, Carrie Coon, Christine Baranski, Kelli O'Hara, Morgan Spector, and more performing a slew of holiday classics and two new songs.

title: Filmmaker Lauren Caster Is Spending 30 Days on the Internet Convincing People to Watch Her Indie
summary: The "Rhythm Is a Dancer" writer/director talks about how she turned her frustrations over getting her movie seen into a marketing tool, and how she harnessed social media to make millions aware of her film.

title: ‘Tiny Fugitives’ Star Johnny Knoxville Blames ‘Fun Police’ for Killing Studio Comedies
summary: Being on "Jackass" helped Knoxville accurately depict being electrocuted by a bunch of unruly teens.

title: ‘Unabomber’ Review: Jacob Tremblay Stuns in a Biopic That Still Can’t Decide If Kaczynski Was Crazy
summary: Russell Crowe adds to the confusion in a biopic that gives Ted Kaczynski a dangerously tidy origin story.

title: America’s New Federal Film Tax Incentive Bill Might Be the One Thing Everyone Agrees on
summary: With a credit up to 30 percent that's fully stackable, it's a "game-changer" that can compete with anywhere.
